selection: Every requested route within an interface must qualify before held; exact world and cells frozen before full; no held-guided geometry selection.
block_requirements: Use existing Map Python and JS validators. Connected owned cells cover actual objects, known moving envelopes and measured action sweeps. Boundary midpoint anchors and internal body staging remain distinct.
geometry_adaptation: Internal action geometry is not scaled. Original bounded terminal adaptation is at most32px per shore; every changed shape, port, mechanism or strategy is a new version with fresh physics. Required recovery terrain remains present.
unknowns: Boundary crossing, arbitrary ingress, enemy full behaviour envelope, vertical adapters and seams require their own actual evidence. No Map terrain or resource reset.
failure_policy: Return fields, searched range and negotiable conditions. Unsupported ideas do not become ordinary platforms; previous failures and local-only candidates retain original identities.
